posts.title: AI as a teaching tool, brief thoughts in Nov 2026
posts.description: Leaving aside AI for research at the moment, as anyone with a pulse knows at this point, we are in a period of rapid change in terms of AI tools and specifically their role in higher education. There is an arms race among universities about what tools should be made available to students.
